title.narrative: Strengthening of HIV and tuberculosis (“TB”) national systems of prevention, treatment, care and support in the Republic of Belarus - Belarus (01-Jan-2025-31-Dec-2027)

description.narrative: Belarus, TB/HIV, Republican Scientific and Practical Center for Medical Technologies, Informatization, Administration and Management of Health (RSPC MT)This program has the following goals: Сurbing the HIV epidemic in a concentrated phase and creating conditions for eliminating HIV infection as a public health risk; stop the spread of drug-sensitive and drug-resistant TB by ensuring universal access to prevention, diagnosis, treatment and care.. The objectives of this program are: Optimization of the HIV response system, including further strengthening of intersectoral and interdepartmental cooperation, treatment coverage of at least 95% of PLHIV, achieving viral suppression of at least 95% of PLHIV receiving treatment. Focus prevention services on key and vulnerable populations according to their needs and the epidemiology of the HIV epidemic, as well as a people- and community-based approach. Building the institutional capacity of HIV service NGOs; development of community’s leadership. Reducing stigma, discrimination and eliminating barriers to access to treatment and prevention of HIV infection. Support for stability of diagnostic treatment, prevention, support and care systems for HIV infection during a pandemic and other public health emergencies. Increase (facility and community level) active TB case detection among KGs as well as contact tracing. Improve early diagnosis of all forms of TB and ensure universal access to DST. Ensure equitable access to quality treatment and continuity of care for all people with drug-resistant TB, including children, through a people-centered care model. Ensure equal access to preventive treatment for high-risk individuals. Implement measures to support TB burden reduction through the involvement of civil society organizations and people affected by TB. Ensure effective implementation of prevention, treatment and care services and interventions through, improved TB surveillance, strengthened procurement, and NTP management
